banner.text: ×INVALID INPUT · MARK THE CROSS STREET ON THE MAP. THE PLAN PLACES IT FROM THERE.GENERATION BLOCKED

×PLAN DECLINED · THE MARKED CROSS STREET IS INSIDE THE WORK ZONE. IT'S 26 FT PAST THE PIN WHERE THE WORK STARTS, AND THE 500 FT WORK ZONE RUNS ON 474 FT BEYOND IT. WORK INSIDE AN INTERSECTION (MUTCD FIGURES 6P-26/27) ISN'T SUPPORTED. MOVE THAT PIN MORE THAN 38 FT FURTHER IN THE DIRECTION OF TRAVEL SO THE WORK STARTS PAST THE CROSS STREET, OR MORE THAN 486 FT BACK AGAINST TRAFFIC SO THE WORK ENDS BEFORE IT. BOTH DISTANCES INCLUDE THE CROSS STREET'S PAVEMENT. IF THE CROSS STREET IS MARKED IN THE WRONG PLACE, MARK IT AGAIN WITH MARK ON MAP.NEEDS INPUT
